## Today's catalysts

- [Nvidia confirms GTC keynote schedule](https://example.com/nvda-gtc) — Nvidia confirmed the GTC keynote timing, focusing investor attention on fresh Blackwell shipment and roadmap details expected today.
- [SK Hynix reports sold-out HBM supply](https://example.com/hynix-hbm) — SK Hynix said HBM capacity is fully allocated through next year, tightening the supply outlook for AI accelerator vendors this quarter.
- [Treasury auction lands ahead of CPI print](https://example.com/auction) — A heavy Treasury auction lands hours before the CPI release, so rate-sensitive tech positioning may stay defensive into the open.

## Market read

Chip supply headlines set the tone this morning. Allocation, not demand, is the axis to watch, and pricing power sits with vendors holding secured HBM supply. Rate volatility around the auction is the main cross-current for tech into the open.
